daycontents: Another day, another box: the new year is getting closer and closer!
Think back to a beautiful moment of this year and to the people who made it special.
It's a good time to write down a small wish for the year to come.
December is a month for looking back: what have you learned this year?
A greeting to someone you haven't heard from in a while can make a difference.
Festive lights brighten up the streets: enjoy the atmosphere of these days.
Think of a goal you reached this year, even a small one: you deserved it.
The countdown continues: every box you open is a step towards the new year.
Today, try to let go of something you don't want to take with you into the new year.
A resolution works better when it's simple and concrete: what could yours be?
The holidays are the right time to be with the people you care about.
Think back to a challenge you overcame this year: you are stronger than you think.
Allow yourself a break: rest is also a great way to end the year.
What would you like to do for the first time in the new year?
A sincere thank you is the best way to say goodbye to the year that is ending.
Have you already thought about how to celebrate the new year?
Every ending is also a new beginning: enjoy these last days of the year.
Try sorting through this year's photos and memories: you'll find some wonderful ones.
The new year is a blank page: what would you like to write on it?
A small act of kindness today is a great way to get ready for the new year.
Every box is a small end-of-year gift: keep up the countdown!
Day by day, the midnight toast is getting closer.
restday_daycontents: Today is a day of rest: enjoy it, the countdown starts again tomorrow.
A break in the countdown: relax and spend time with the people you love.
No box to discover today: allow yourself a quiet day.
Even the wait for the new year needs a break. See you tomorrow!
A day of rest: recharge your energy for the celebrations ahead.
Today we slow down. The surprises start again tomorrow!
daycontent_first: The countdown has begun! Every day a new box will accompany you until the first day of the new year.
daycontent_last: Happy New Year! The countdown is over: may the new year bring you serenity, health and many reasons to be happy. Best wishes to you and your loved ones!
